scope: NEW LastFMAsia and Amazon Photo node-classification development study
source_review: Manual textual inspection and interface coordination with model/design agents only
test_target_contract: Graph input has no y; development target arrays contain training/validation targets only; held-out targets separately retained and hashed; no scientific test reader exists
split_contract: Classwise floor test, classwise floor validation in remaining pool, training remainder; same held-out nodes across every split
selection_contract: Minimum arithmetic-probability-pool validation NLL; exact ties earliest; mean-logit pool same-checkpoint sensitivity only
untied_optimizer_contract: Independent disjoint-member optimizers; sum individual node-mean CE for backward; log mean member CE
raw_target_storage_contract: Full-label author raw snapshots are retained in the sealed acquisition area, outside public fit inputs
qualification_evaluation_contract: Scheduled no-grad full forward and stable pooled train-only evaluation, with times separate from complete updates
cold_calls_contract: One first label-free forward of the initial untrained model; not cold selected-checkpoint inference. Model/input transfers and later selected-checkpoint reload are reported separately
fresh_selected_deployment_contract: Repeated within-process fresh CPU model + model-only checkpoint reload/state application + model/graph/features/gather-ID device transfers + pooled output. No labels/optimizer/old resident model; direct per-repeat totals, median/p95. Process/import/CUDA context/OS cache initialization excluded
validation_metric_contract: Macro-F1 across all C output classes, zero-denominator0; argmax disagreement averaged across unordered member pairs, null for one member
fixed_operation_breakdown_contract: Optional frozen full graph forward, development gather, probability pool timings; isolated resident fixtures and synchronization, not an additive decomposition or speedup claim
per_update_audits: Same finite-gradient/nonzero-gradient-tensor/finite-parameter checks, batched reductions with one host result per category
resource_contract: One coordinator GPU job lock, explicit protocol warmups/repeats and full updates, no operation-count speedup claim; independent root forecast/admission required
